query:
UPDATE users SET
                 failed_logins = CASE WHEN failed_logins + 1 >= $2 THEN 0 ELSE failed_logins + 1 END,
                 locked_until  = CASE WHEN failed_logins + 1 >= $2
                                      THEN now() + make_interval(mins => $3) ELSE locked_until END
               WHERE id = $1
